funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Author Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals at any career stage with a confirmed publisher and a publication date within three years.
opportunities.summary: Financial support for publishing monographs, edited collections, catalogues and articles reflecting advanced research in British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Individual Research Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals at any career stage; up to £3,000 for all, £3,001‑£8,000 for all, £8,001‑£20,000 for postdoctoral level or above. Open to international applicants.
opportunities.summary: Flexible funding for research travel and/or research time to undertake British art research.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Study Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Students enrolled in or about to start a master's or doctoral degree in British art, visual culture or architecture.
opportunities.summary: Fixed‑amount support to help students begin or continue postgraduate study in British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Andrew Wyld Research Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered students (undergraduate level and above) from any country researching eighteenth‑ or nineteenth‑century British works on paper.
opportunities.summary: Support for travel to examine historical works on paper (prints, drawings, watercolours) firsthand.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Master's Degree Scholarship
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals with an offer for a master's degree (MA, MPhil, MSc or equivalent) at a UK institution, commencing between April 2027 and April 2028.
opportunities.summary: Full funding for a one‑year master’s programme (or split over two years part‑time) in British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Doctoral Scholarship

amount.raw: £96,000 total (£32,000 per year for three years)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals with an offer for a doctorate at a UK university, starting between April 2027 and April 2028; open to international applicants (fees may differ).
opportunities.summary: Full funding for doctoral research in British art, covering tuition and living costs.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Early Career Fellowship

amount.raw: £35,000 for one year or £70,000 for two years

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Postdoctoral‑level researchers (or equivalent experience) or above.
opportunities.summary: Funding to undertake a major research project that will reshape understanding of British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Rome Fellowship
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Scholars, researchers, curators, archivists and GLAM professionals (pre‑doctoral to senior) with at least a first degree, proposing research on British‑Italian cultural exchange.
opportunities.summary: Three‑month residential fellowship at the British School at Rome with board, accommodation and honorarium.
